cities.name: Athens
cities.local_food_tip: Gyros, souvlaki, fresh seafood, salads, olives — classic Greek flavors with Mediterranean freshness. 🥗🍢🐟
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Visit Acropolis & Parthenon, explore ancient ruins and historic landmarks. → ☕ Coffee and traditional breakfast in old town.

Afternoon: 🚶 Stroll through narrow alleys of Plaka, visit museums or local markets → 🍽️ Lunch: Greek mezze or seafood by a terrace. → 🌇 Walk up to a hilltop viewpoint for city panorama.

Sunset: 🌅 Sunset view over Athens roofs and hills — golden hour over history and modern city. 

Night: 🌙 Dinner in traditional taverna, maybe live music, evening strolls through lively streets — blend of ancient and contemporary Greece.

ideas: 🌼 Pleasant weather for sightseeing and walking ancient sites without summer crowd.
🎨 Outdoor cafés, markets and cultural events as city awakens.
🚶 Exploring old town streets under gentle sun — relaxed pace.
🌞 Early sightseeing, midday rest, then evening strolls or rooftop dinners under warm sky.
🍹 Cold drinks, seafood, ice‑cream and relaxed nights after hot days.
🌇 Sunset walks and late‑night culture under warm summer nights.
🍂 Soft light and pleasant temperature — ideal for photos around ancient sites.
🥘 Hearty meals with Greek flavors and warm hospitality as days cool.
🏺 Indoor museums or cultural visits if weather changes.
🌤️ Mild winter weather — still good for city walks and sightseeing.
🔥 Warm meals, local dishes and cozy taverna dinners after chilly evenings.
🎭 Less crowd — peaceful exploration of historic sites and city corners.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use metro and buses to navigate city and reach outskirts easily.
🚶 Old town and central areas walkable — good for sightseeing on foot.
🚲 Bikes or scooters may help for short hops or beachfront promenades.
🎟️ Day‑pass for public transport useful if exploring multiple areas.

city_events.description: 🎶 Open‑air concerts, nightlife and cultural events across the city.

cities.name: Santorini & Aegean Islands (Summer / Sea Escape)
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh seafood, greek salad, local wine, light meals and Mediterranean cuisine — perfect after beach or sea activities. 🍷🐙🥗
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Sunrise or early‑morning walk along cliffs, enjoy sea view and calm sea atmosphere. → 🏖️ Beach or boat trip — swim, sun or relax by the sea.

Afternoon: 🐠 Lunch by the coast — seafood or fresh Mediterranean dishes. → 🚶 Explore island streets, white houses, narrow alleys and sea‑view terraces.

Sunset: 🌇 Iconic island sunset over caldera or sea — unforgettable panorama and relaxed vibe. 

Night: 🌙 Dinner with sea breeze, local wine or cocktails, slow island pace and starry skies over Aegean.

ideas: 🌼 Mild weather before summer rush — nice for peaceful walks and island discovery.
🚤 Boat rides or coastal walks while temperatures are moderate.
🍃 Fresh sea air, fewer tourists — perfect for relaxed island vibe.
🏖️ Full beach mode — swimming, sun, sea and water fun all day.
🌙 Evening dinners by sea, sunset views and lively nightlife in island bars.
🍨 Fresh meals, local drinks and relaxed coastal lifestyle under warm nights.
🍂 Milder temperature, calm sea — pleasant for sightseeing without summer heat.
🥘 Hearty Mediterranean meals after day trips or hikes.
🌅 Stunning sunsets and soft light over seas and islands — perfect for photos.
🌊 Sea breeze, empty beaches and peaceful coastal walks — serene and reflective.
🔥 Warm seafood or local dishes, cozy indoor meals and calm village nights.
🎑 Starry skies, calm seas and tranquil island atmosphere out of tourist season.

public_transport_tips: ⛵ Ferry or boat transport between islands or coastal spots — main travel mode in summer.
🚶 On island — walking is best to explore narrow alleys, old villages and scenic spots.
🚐 For remote corners — local buses or scooter/car rental may help.
🎫 Check ferry schedules and local transport passes in high season.

city_events.name: Aegean Summer Island Fest
city_events.description: 🌅 Beach parties, music the sea, local food, island nightlife and Mediterranean summer vibe.

cities.name: Stavros (Halkidiki)
cities.local_food_tip: Seafood, fresh fish, Greek salads, olive oil, mezze and local wines — ideal light meals after beach or sea activities. 🐟🥗🍷
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Early stroll or swim on the beach — calm waters and soft morning light. → ☕ Breakfast in seaside taverna with seaside view.

Afternoon: 🏖️ Beach time — swim, sunbathe or relax under pine trees by sea → 🍽️ Lunch: grill fish or light seafood with fresh vegetables.

Sunset: 🌇 Coastal walk or small cliff/beach viewpoint for sunset over Aegean — beautiful panorama and laid‑back vibe.

Night: 🌙 Dinner with coastal breeze, local wine or ouzo; relaxed seaside ambience, casual tavernas and calm village nightlife.

ideas: 🌼 Mild sea and weather — nice for quiet beach walks before summer crowds.
🚶 Coastal pine‑lined paths for light hiking or strolling.
☀️ Outdoor meals with sea breeze and early sunshine.
🏖️ Swimming, sun, sea — full summer mode in a relaxed village setting.
🍹 Fresh seafood dinners, chilled drinks and laid‑back nights by the sea.
🎶 Small local music, seaside tavernas or casual summer events under stars.
🍂 Gentle autumn light — perfect for beach walks and seaside photos.
🔥 Warm seafood or Greek comfort meals after cooler evenings.
🌊 Quiet sea, fewer tourists — peaceful coastal escape.
🌬️ Fresh sea air and calm coasts — peaceful for reflection or walks.
🛏️ Cozy tavernas, warm meals and local hospitality in quiet village atmosphere.
🌧️ Occasional rainy sea weather — good for indoor rest or nearby excursions.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Local buses connect to main towns or coastal hubs — check seasonal schedule.
🚶 Village and beach area walkable — best explored on foot or by bicycle.
🚗 Renting a car or scooter gives fleksibility da istražiš obližnje plaže i okolinu.
🎒 Ponesi dobru obuću i opremu za more i sunce — prirodna sredina + plaža.

city_events.description: 🌅 Beach life, seaside dinners, local food & relaxed coastal vibe under summer sky.

cities.name: Halkidiki (Kassandra peninsula)
cities.local_food_tip: Tzatziki, fresh seafood, grilled meats, local salads — Mediterranean diet with chill summer mood. 🍢🐙🥗
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏝️ Start at one of the sandy beaches — swim, sunbathing or water sports. → ☕ Breakfast or light brunch at beachfront café.

Afternoon: 🚤 Boat trip along coast or visit nearby secluded coves → 🍽️ Lunch: mezze or seafood by the sea.

Sunset: 🌇 Promenade or beach‑side bar for sunset cocktails and sea view. 

Night: 🌃 Summer nightlife — tavernas, bars, beach‑parties, live music or just relaxed coastal ambience under warm sky.

ideas: 🌼 Mild spring weather — good for beach walks and early visits before crowds.
🌿 Coastal pine forests + sea breeze — nice for nature lovers and light hikes.
🚶 Calm villages and seaside towns before busy season start.
🏖️ Days at sea, parties at night — full summer tourist experience.
🍧 Ice‑cream, chilled drinks, seafood dinners by sea after hot day.
🎶 Beach bars and live‑music nightlife along coast under stars.
🍁 Sea calm, softer sun — ideal for tranquil beach walks and coastal relaxation.
🥘 Local meals, sea‑food and warm evenings with Mediterranean taste.
📸 Beautiful light for photography — sea + coast + calm mood.
🌬️ Fresh sea air, quiet coastlines — good for offseason escapes and reflection.
🔥 Warm meals, local hospitality — calm village or small town experience.
🚶 Nature coastal walks — peaceful, calm and uncrowded.

public_transport_tips: 🚆 Nearest big city + bus/ shuttle do poluostrva — plan prevoz unapred ako letiš van sezone.
🚶 Mnogi delovi poluostrva su pogodna za pešačenje — potrudi se da biraš blizu plaže/centra.
🚗 Auto ili motor‑scooter može da olakša istraživanje različitih plaža i manjih mesta.
🎫 Tokom sezone — raspitaj se za lokalne karte / kombi‑prevoz, može da bude gužve.

city_events.name: Halkidiki Summer Beach Parties
city_events.description: 🎉 Beach parties, boat trips, seaside dining and lively summer vibe on the peninsula.

cities.name: Mykonos (Cyclades Islands)
cities.local_food_tip: Seafood, fresh fish, mezze, Mediterranean salads, local cheeses and island wines — perfect after boat rides or sea swims. 🐠🥗🍷
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌊 Swim or relax by the sea, enjoy calm waters and island air → 🍴 Brunch on beachfront tavernas.

Afternoon: 🚶 Explore whitewashed villages, windmills, narrow alleys and local shops → 🍽️ Lunch: seafood or light Mediterranean dish.

Sunset: 🌇 Famous Mykonos sunset — stroll along coast or find a rooftop with sea view for golden hour.

Night: 🌙 Party mood — beach bars, clubs, nightlife, music & drinks under island sky; or relaxed dinner by the sea, depending on vibe.

ideas: 🌼 Mild weather — nice for exploring villages and coastal paths before summer crowds.
🚶 Quiet streets, local island culture and relaxed pace.
🍷 Try local wine and seafood in calm tavernas.
🏖️ Beach, sea, sun — full island holiday (sun & swim & relax).
🎉 Nightlife, beach parties, social vibe and Mediterranean fun under stars.
🍨 Chill days & lively nights — classic island mix.
🍂 Fewer turisti — mirnije plaže, niža cena i spokojna atmosfera.
🍲 Regional jela, sveža riba i domaće vino u mirnim restoranima.
📷 Lepi kadrovi belih sela, plavetnilo mora i jesenja svetlost.
🌤️ Mirlje, tiha mesta — lepa opcija za miran beg od gužve.
🔥 Topla jela, domaće taverne, tišina ostrva i priroda.
🚶 Šetnje uz obalu, istraživanje sela i romantika ostrvske zime.

public_transport_tips: ⛴️ Trajekti i brodovi — glavni način pristupa ostrvu i prelaza između ostrva.
🚶 Unutar ostrva — pešaka ili lokalnim prevozom, jer su mesta blizu i šeta se lako.
🏍️ Skuter ili motor‑bicikl može da bude zgodna opcija za istraživanje ostrva.
🎫 Tokom sezone — pogledaj pakete trajekta + smeštaja + prevoza da uštediš.

city_events.name: Mykonos Summer Island Festival
city_events.description: 🌅 Beach parties, island nightlife, music events and classic Mediterranean island vibe.
